description: This Java source file defines a Spring component class 'DataInitializer' that implements application startup seeding logic. It creates sample customers, accounts, account-customer relationships, and initial transactions for development or profile-specific environments, ensuring the database is pre-populated with initial data during app startup.

classes.name: DataInitializer
classes.description: A Spring component that seeds initial customer, account, account-customer relationships, and transactions data on application startup for 'dev' and 'initdata' profiles.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method invoked on application startup that seeds data if not already present, creating customers, accounts, relationships, and initial transactions.

methods.name: ensureCustomer
methods.description: Finds existing customer by personal details or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: ensureAccount
methods.description: Finds existing account by account number or creates a new one with specified details.

methods.name: ensureXref
methods.description: Creates a customer-account relationship if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ensureInitialDeposit
methods.description: Creates an initial deposit transaction for an account if none exists, updating account balance accordingly.
